name: codeforces-mcp
description: Codeforces (competitions): discover, get_competition, standings. Every tool maps to a documented end

tools.name: discover
tools.description: All regular (non-gym) contests, upcoming first, then finished ones newest first; the method takes no filters, so the server filters locally (query: substring of the title; kind: every contest is coding; status: open = CODING, upcoming = BEFORE, completed = FINISHED) and pages the matches. status in the results is Codeforces' phase (BEFORE, CODING, PENDING_SYSTEM_TEST, SYSTEM_TEST, FINISHED).

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: The Contest object from contest.standings (the API has no single-contest method); anonymous callers get it only for public regular contests that have started. Large contests answer several MB: the answer is held for 60 s and a following standings call for the same contest pages it without downloading it again.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Official public standings; the API forbids from/count for anonymous callers, so the full ranklist is fetched and paged locally. raw has penalty and per-problem results.
